title: Python self-signed SCHC control can raise inside LinkLayer.receive
description: SchcSessionManager.record_verified_frame derives fragmentation direction for ACK/Receiver-Abort after LinkLayer has replay-accepted and stored the receipt. If authenticated sender identity equals the local signer, fragmentation_rule_for_sender raises FragmentError for the non-peer pair and the exception escapes LinkLayer.receive instead of leaving the frame for higher-layer rejection. Catch equal/invalid endpoint direction during opportunistic sender-control registration, preserve the normal authenticated receive contract, and add a self-signed ambiguous-control regression showing no sender/reassembly mutation.
